text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All riiiiiiight, let's gooooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Classmates
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo, nice shot!!
The whole class is rooting for you,
so make sure you really stand out at the U.A.F.!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, thank you soooo much!!!!
To have everyone cheer me on like this—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOOOOOH!!!!
I'm overflowing with motivationnnnn!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Whoaaa, Ticket-san is so fired up!!
Right? You just love sports, don't you??
Augh, pure wholesome KAWAII!!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (Aaaah, but still, if Ticket-san gets that much attention—)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Why?! It's not fair!!
All everyone cares about is tickets...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it is, I'm gonna mess things up with pranks!
Just you watch~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Awawa... I knew ittt!!
Lady Windy pouting because she's not the center of attention is so freaking adooorable!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(—Wait, that's not it!! I want to cheer for Ticket-san,
but I also want to let Lady Windy
pull off her cute little pranks!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I-Is there anything I can do?!
Something to help Ticket-san,
and satisfy Windy-chan-sama too—)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mess with her practice... Hmm, what should I do—?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Passing Voice
text_block_list.text:
Dunks look so cool~~!
Though if the hoop were any higher,
not even Ticket-zo-san could reach it, I bet~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that's the spirit!! I'm gonna do it!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huhh!? Doesn't the goal
look higher than it was earlier!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose, though~! Even a towering wall,
I'll scale it with pure spiritーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLUNK!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It made it through!!!! Waaahhh! I overcame it--!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What kind of monster is she!?
If that's how it's gonna be, then I'll just push the goal even further—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see, Windy set the goal higher for me!
So that I could reach even greater heights!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*Waaaaahhh*!! Thank youuuu!!
Thanks to Windy, I finally understand
how important it is to take on challenges, waaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Classmates
text_block_list.text: "Whoaaa, that's awesome, Windy!! You went out of your way to set up a goal just for that?"

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Classmates
text_block_list.text: You're so nice! And wow, you're great at teaching! Teach me next time too~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh... Wait...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, naturally!! When Windy-chan's on the job, something like this is a piece of cake!
Worship me more, come on!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Windy~~~!!!!
I'm zo touched, thank you soooo much!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Mmmgh~, seeing the two of them look so happy!
It's such a feast for the eyes... Hallelujah!!!)
